source.title: Hippocampal place-cell sequences depict future paths to remembered goals

confidence_rationale: Canonical Nature single-unit study with a direct, prospective result: pre-navigation hippocampal sequences are biased toward the upcoming path to a remembered goal. Maps strongly onto INF-7/ARC-091's claim that hippocampal output supplies prospective hypotheses (L1). Held below 0.85 only by the animal->REE-architecture transfer (rat spatial trajectory vs REE's general state-as-navigable latent).
failure_signatures: If hippocampal output were pure retrieval (past trajectories only), the inference-layer framing of replay-as-hypothesis-generator would be wrong; the result instead shows future-biased, goal-directed sequences.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Before goal-directed navigation, hippocampal place cells generate brief (~ripple-timescale) sequences encoding spatial trajectories that progress from the rat's current location toward a known goal location, providing direct evidence that place-cell sequences can depict future paths.
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds the INF-7/ARC-091 premise that hippocampal completion/replay (ARC-007/ARC-018) is not merely memory retrieval but a generator of prospective candidate trajectories -- the raw material the inference layer turns into a belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) and inferred affordances. The 'depict future paths to goals' result is the biology behind 'given partial evidence, propose a route'.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper measures literal spatial trajectories to a visible/remembered reward location in an open arena; REE's inference layer claims a far more general state-hypothesis construction under partial observability. The transfer assumes spatial prospective sequencing generalises to non-spatial relational state inference -- plausible (see Whittington 2020) but not demonstrated here.
mapping.source_context: Rat dorsal CA1 tetrode ensemble recordings; open-field goal-directed navigation task.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (Nature, well-replicated prospective-replay line). Mapping fidelity strong for the 'replay = prospective hypothesis' half of L1; transfer risk moderate (spatial->general-relational).
